This is first bail application filed by the applicant under Section 439 of the Cr.P.C. for grant of regular bail relating to FIR No.604/2022 dated 23.9.2022, registered at Police Station - Kohefiza,
District - Bhopal for commission of offence under Sections 420, 467, 468, 471 and 201 of IPC.

He is in detention since 16.11.2022.

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the applicant has submitted that prosecutrix along with the accused had filed compromise deed before this Court and she in her statement before the Registrar has stated that she has contracted marriage with the applicant and in this regard, Nikahnama was executed.
It is further submitted that applicant is in jail for more than one year and even prosecutrix has not been cross-examined so far.
Therefore, it has been prayed that applicant may be released on bail pending the trial.
4 . O n the other hand, learned counsel for the State has opposed the prayer for grant of bail to the applicant.

5. Considering the detention period of the applicant and other facts and circumstances of the case,
but without expressing anything on the merits of the case, I am of the view that it is a case in which further pre-trial detention of the applicant is not warranted.

Consequently, this first bail application under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure for grant of bail filed on behalf of applicant,
stands allowed.

6 . It is directed that applicant - Ismail Saiyyed Ibrahim Saiyed be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.2,00,000/- (Rupees Two Lakh only) with two solvent sureties of Rs.1,00,000/- (Rupees One Lac only) each to the satisfaction of the trial Court, for his regular appearance before the trial Court during trial with a condition that he shall remain present before the concerned Court on all the dates fixed by it during trial.

He shall abide by all the conditions enumerated under Section 437(3) of Cr.P.C.
7 .
This order shall be effective till the end of the trial.
However, in case o f bail jump and breach of any of the conditions of bail, it shall become ineffective.
Certified copy as per rules.
